findings.desc: No dsh.bundle manifest declared (installed as a plain dep, never activated)
findings.fix: Add a dsh.bundle.patch declaration in package.json (e.g. "dsh": { "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" } })

findings.fix: Run the build: cd <plugin-dir> && pnpm install && pnpm build (or the build command in package.json scripts)
